tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal kyai rdo rje la brten pa'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi rnam par bshad pa ye shes me phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bkra shis par gyur cig //na mas saṅgu ru pā dā ya/ gang zhig gnyis med ye shes dpal ni gzung 'dzin rgyu dang 'bras bu la sogs tshogs pa kun bral ci la'ang mi gnas chos kyi sku/ /gang de'i mthu las mtshan dpe'i dpal mnga' smon lam rgyu can kha sbyor bde sogs tshogs pa dang ldan zhi la mi gnas longs spyod rdzogs/ /gang 'dul sna tshogs thabs kyis dpal bsnyes thugs rje'i rgyu las rab 'bring tha sogs tshogs la dbang bsgyur bdag bder mi gnas sprul pa ste/ /sku gsum dbyer med dpal ldan bla ma dges pa rdo rjer gus pas 'dud do deng nas bzung ste byang chub bar du bdag skyongs shig /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i dbus na mngon par mtho zhing skal bzang gser ri'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba/ /mtshan rtog rlung gis bskyed par mi nus pa'i/ /grags pa'i mtshan can sa 'dzin dbang po rgyal/ /kun la ma ltar nye ba'i thugs rje dang / /dga' bzhi'i mthar son lhan skyes mngon 'gyur pa'i/ /bzang po bstan dang 'gro ba skyong ngo zhes/ /lung bstan brnyes pa de la'ang phyag bgyi 'o/ /rnam mang 'gro la phan bde kun slad dang / /rnam dag bstan pa rgyas par bya phyir du/ /rnam spyod mang pos rgyud don ji lta bar/ /rnam gzhag 'khrul med zhib mor 'chad par spro/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bcas nas/ gang bshad par bya ba'i chos ni/ dpal kyai rdo rje la brten pa'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan zhabs kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa 'di'o/ /'di la gnyis te/ cho ga dngos dang / de'i phan yon kha bskangs nas bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ sa'i cho ga nges pa'i tshig dgos pa/ dgos can gyi cho ga dngos so/ /dang po ni/ sngar sa'i cho ga byas zin pa'i phyogs su ni mi dgos la/

ma byas pa'i sar ni cho ga re nges par bya dgos so/ /de yang rgyas bsdus ji ltar rig pa dkyil chog rnams las 'byung ba bzhin bya ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ dang po sa ni yongs bzung la/ /phyis ni thab khung yang dag brtsam/ /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ sngags kyis sa ni sbyangs nas ni/ /me yi thab dag bya ba ste/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du kha sbyor sogs rgyud dang bstan bcos du ma las 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ sbyin sreg gi skad dod la ho ma zhes 'byung zhing de la yi ge phyis bsnan gyi nges tshig gis/ ho ni he ta bya ste bsreg bya/ ma yig na ra byas pas de na sbyin pa ste/ bsreg bya'i rdzas rnams me lha'i khar gter bas sbyin sreg go gsung / de yang kha sbyor las/ me ni lha'i kha ru gsungs/ /sbyin sreg de nyid rnam par gnas/ /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ lha kun zhal ni me yin pas/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ nges tshig de dang ldan pa'i sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ gnas skabs su lha rnams mnyes shing / cho ga'i lhag chad kyi nyes pa 'joms pa dang / sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba sogs las rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / mthar thug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang bde blag tu 'grub pa'i las su mchog grub 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod de/ /kha sbyor las/ /sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshim/ /tshim par gyur nas dngos grub stsol/ /gang zhig sngags kyi lhag chad dag /de kun sbyin sreg gis ni bskongs/ /zhes dang / ye shes thig le las/ de bas kun nas 'bad pa yis/ /rnam pa thams cad mchog gi rgyur/ /mchod sbyin sbyin sreg gtor ma bya/ /bsod nams tshogs ni phal cher dang / /sems can phan 'dod de dag bya/ /zhes so/ /de ltar na bstan bcos gzhan las/ sbyin sreg la sogs pa de dag mchog thun mong gnyis kyi phyi ma sgrub byed kyi thabs su bshad pa dang 'gal lo/ /zhe na skyon med de/ de ltar bshad pa ni gtso che chung tsam la dgongs pa yin la/

/'dir ni bshad ma thag par rnam pa thams cad sogs dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ bsod nams tshogs kyi rgyu don dang / /ye shes tshogs rdzogs bya phyir ro/ /zhes cho ga 'di'i skabs su 'byung zhing / de bzhin du rgyud mang po'i dngos bstan las gsung pas so/ /de ltar bshad pa'i sa phyogs sogs gsum ni/ gzhung 'dir mi snang yang nye bar mkho bas bris pa yin no/ /yang las bzhi so so'i dgos pa ni/ rang gzhan gyi rims nad sogs nyer 'tshe dang sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba dang / tshe dang bsod nams sogs rgyas pa dang / 'gro ba rnams dbang du bsdu ba dang / gdug pa can bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya ba rnams yin no/ /de skad du nag po spyod pas/ sdig pa 'jigs phyir zhi ba ste/ /bsod nams yongs su spel rgyas yin/ /chags par bsgom ni dbang 'gyur te/ /rtog pa gsad phyir mngon spyod yin/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa cho ga dngos la/ rtsa ba'i las bzhi las phye ba'i dgug pa dang / sdang ba sogs rgyud rnams las dbye sgo du ma zhig gsungs pa thams cad gzhung 'dir zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhir bsdu bar mdzad pa ni/ ye shes thig le las/ sbyin sreg sdig pa 'jig byed pa/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang / /de bzhin dbang dang mngon spyod do/ /zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ las bzhi po yi nang 'dus pa/ /thab khung gis ni nang lhag ma/ /slar yang de rnams khyad par ni/ /bshad par bya yi lha mo nyon/ /zhes pa'i rjes su dgug pa sogs bstan cing / de bzhin du gzhan las kyang 'byung bas ma 'dus pa'i skyon med la/ ji ltar 'du tshul ni/ dgug pa sogs dbang gi dang / sdas ba sogs drag po'i nang du 'dus shing / lung rnams ni ji ltar rig pa 'og nas 'byung ngo / /de lta bu'i las bzhi'i cho ga nyams su len tshul bshad pa la gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po la/ thab dang bud shing sbar ba me/ /rjas dang bsham thabs sgrub pa 'o/

/zhes pa ltar drug gi dang po la so so'i dang / las thams cad pa'i thabs bshad pa la gnyis/ dang po la/ /dbyibs dang tshad dang kha dog dang / /mtshan ma mu ran rnams lnga 'o/ /zhes pa de rnams las bzhi ka la sbyar bar bya ba yin pas zhi ba'i dbang du byas na/ dang po ni/ zhi ba'i sogs te/ nad la sogs pa zhi bar byed pas zhi ba zhes bya bzhin/ las de bsgrub pa'i thab khung gi dbyibs ye shes rnam rtog gi zur dang bral ba mtshon par byed pas zlum po ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ zhi bar thab khung zlum po nyid/ /ces dang / gur las/ zlum po zhi bar byed par brjod/ /ces dang / ye shes thig le las/ zhi ba'i hom khung zlum po yin/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshad sogs te/ so phag sogs kyis brtsigs sam/ khung bur brus sam/ mtshon gyis bris kyang rung ste/ thab kyi rgya tshad khru gang dang / zabs de'i steng du khru phyed yod par bya ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ khru gang dang ni khru phyed nyid/ /zhi ba'i steng dang 'og tu yin/ /zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' sbyor las/ khru gang tshad tsam thig gdab bya/ /thig btab khru phyed brkos nas ni/ /'og tu sa la tho gang khung / /zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ /zhi la sa yi cha ni dkar/ /khru gang tshad tsam rab zlum pa/ /'og tu mtho gang tshad tsam brkos/ /zhes dang / rin chen 'bar ba las/ khru gang ba dang khru phyed pa/ /rgya dang zabs ni zhi ba ste/ /zhes dang / grub chen mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'brel pa pad+ma can las/ khru gang rgya la mtho gang zabs/ /'khor lo lta bur zlom pa 'o/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ kha dog sogs ste/ zhi ba'i thab khung 'dis kha dog dang dbyibs kyi sgo nas 'byung ba bzhi las chu'i dkyil 'khor mtshon cing chus dri ma khrud/ tsha ba dang skom pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa ltar/ thab khung 'di la brten nas kyang sdig sgrib dang nad gdon sogs zhi bar nus pas dkar po ste/

thams cad gsang ba las/ chu yi dkyil 'khor zlum po ste/ /dkar po'i mdog can zhi ba yin/ /zhes so/ /de la thab kyi rang bzhin gyi dkar ba yod na des mchog la/ de ltar ma yin na brus pa dang / brtsigs pa'i phyogs la 'byor pa dang ldan pas tsan+dan dkar po'i khu bas dang / ma 'byor na rdo rgyus sogs dkar zhal gyis byugs cing / bris pa'i phyogs la ni rdul mtshon dkar po nyid kyi chog par gsungs so/ /de yang rtsa rgyud las/ zhi bar kha dog dkar por 'gyur/ /zhes dang / kha sbyor las/ zhi ba kha dog dkar po yin/ /zhes dang / de nyid las/ tsan+dan dkar pos ngos dag byugs/ /ces dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ /lci ba dang ni sa dkar gyis/ /thab khung sa ni nye bar byug /brtul zhugs can gyis sting 'og tu/ /dkar po'i dri yis nye bar byug /ces dang / mi thub zla bas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog bzang po yongs bzung ngam/ legs par bsdu ba las/ zhi ba rdul mtshon dkar po ste/ /zhes dang / rin chen 'bar ba las/ phye ma dkar pos zhi ba las/ /zhes dang / pad can las/shar du sa dkar gyis byas te/ /tsan+dan gyis ni nye bar byug /sa mtshon me tog dkar po 'grams/ /zhes so/ bzhi pa ni/ mtshan ma sogs ste/ 'di ni las bzhi ka'i thun mong ba yin/ so so'i thab kyi nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyud lte ba dang bcas pa la yab kyi phyogs la rtsa rgyud phyi ma'am lnga par gsungs pa bzhin rang rang gi sku mdog dang mthun par so so'i phyag mtshan bri zhing / mi nus na mtshon spungs tsam bya'o/ /gal te rtsa rgyud kyi lung ni smin byed kyi dkyil 'khor la dgongs/ 'dir sbyar bar bya ba ma yin no/ /snyam na de ltar ni ma yin te/ skabs 'dir pad can las/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad dbus chud par/ /lte ba la ni thod pa bzhag /de nas sna tshogs rdo rje bri/ /zhes bshad pas so/ /yum gyi phyogs la ni lte ba'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir nang gi rnal 'byor ma lnga dang /

'dab brgyad kyi shar nub gnyis su steng 'og gi lha mo gnyis bkod nas gau rī sogs yab kyi skabs dang 'dra bar bya ba yin te/ pad can las/ lha mo'i mtshan ma'i dbus gnas pa/ /kyai rdo rje'i phyogs la 'di/ /zhes yab kyi phyogs bstan pa'i rjes thogs su/ bdag med ma'i sgrub pa ni/ /gri gug lnga dang ldan pa yis/ /zhes so/ lnga pa ni/ 'dir kha khyer sogs te/ thab kyi dngos gzhi khru gang de'i phyi rol du sor bzhi bskyed pa kha khyer dang / de'i phyi nas sor bzhi steng du langs pa mu ran yin zhing de gnyis gang rung la rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /bri la dngos su de ltar med kyang bsgom don la snga ma ji lta bar dgos shing / bri tshul ni/ yang na sogs te go sla'o/ /de dag kyang kha sbyor las/ de yi phyi rol zlum por sa/ /sor bzhir pa yi mu ran yin/ /zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ thab khung nang du rang gi ni/ /sor tshad bzhi ni dor bar bya/ /kha khyer gyi ni zheng dang tshad/ /kun tu sor bzhi tshad du bya/ /mtshams rnams su ni rdo rje ste/ /rtse gsum pa yis rdo rjes mtshan/ /zhes dang / legs bsdus las/ de nas bzhi dang kha khyer te/ /phyi ru rdo rje'i phreng ba 'o/ /zhes dang / pad can las/ ngos su sor bzhi dor byas te/ /de tshad kha khyer rdo rje yi/ /ra ba yis ni mdzes par bskor/ /zhes zhi ba la sbyar nas bstan zin to/ /da ni rgyas pa'i phyogs la brjod na/ dang po dbyibs ni/ rgyas pa'i tshogs te/ tshe dang bsod nams sogs gong 'phel du byed pas rgyas pa zhes bya la/ don de sgrub pa'i thab khung ni me long mnyam nyid sor rtog bya grub ste ye shes bzhir mtshon pas gru bzhi pa ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ rgyas pa nyid kyi gru bzhi pa/ /zhes dang / kha sbyor las/ rgyas pa thab khung gru bzhi ste/ /zhes dang / ye shes thig le las/ rgyas pa yi ni gru bzhi 'o/ /zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/

yang na gru bzhi pa ru bya/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ brgyar sogs te/ brtsig sam/ brus sam/ bris pa gang yin kyang thab kyi dngos gzhi'i rgyar khru do dang / dpangs su de nyid kyi phyed du byas pa khru gang pa ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ khru gang dang ni khru do nyid/ /rgyas pa'i steng dang 'og tu brjod/ /ces dang / kha sbyor las/ khru gnyis tshad du rnam par rgyas/ /'og tu khung bur khru gang ba/ /zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ rgya ru khru do dpangs khru gang / zhes dang / rin chen 'bar ba las/ khru do pa dang khru gang pa/ /rgya dang zabs ni rgyas pa'i yin/ /zhes dang / pad can las/ khru gcig pa dang khru gnyis pa/ /logs dang dpangs su rgyas pa las/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ kha dog sogs te/ 'di'i 'byung bzhi sa'i dkyil 'khor mtshon cing bas rtsi shing dang ro bcun sna tshogs bskyed par byed pa bzhin/ 'di'i kha dog ser ba sogs kyis kyang / tshe dang bsod nams sogs rgyas par byed pa ste/ thams cad gsang ba las/ dbang chen kha dog ser ba ste/ /gru bzhi pa de rgyas pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de yang sa rang bzhin gyis ser ba dang / de ltar ma yin na gur gum mam/ sa ser po'i chus byug pa dang / dri'i phyogs la rdul mtshon ser pos bya ba dang / de bzhin du las lhag ma gnyis la yang rang bzhin gyis dmar ba dang / de dang mi ldan na tsan+dan dmar po'i khu ba'am/ btsag la sogs pa'i byug pa dang / rdul mtshon dmar po dang / drag po la sa rang bzhin gyis nag pa dang / de dang mi ldan na dur khrod kyi sol bas byugs pa dang / rdul mtshon nag pos bris pa sogs shes par bya'o/ /de yang skabs 'dir rtsa rgyud las/ rgyas par ser po de bzhin te/ /zhes dang / kha sbyor las/ me tog ser pos brgyan pa dang / /dri ni ser pos rjes su byugs/ /zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ kha dog ser pos sa la ni/ /zhes dang / legs bsdus las/ rgyas pa rdul mtshon ser por bya/

/zhes dang / pad can las/ kha dog ser po'i sa yis byugs/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa mtshan ma 'god pa ni/ gong du bshad pa bzhin las lhag ma gsum char la shes par bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ kha khyer sogs te thab kyi dngos gzhi khru do las phyi rol du sor brgyad bskyed pa kha khyer dang / de'i phyi nas sor brgyad steng du langs pa mu ran yin zhing de gnyis gang rung la rin po che'i phreng bas mtshan pa ste/ kha sbyor las/ mu ran la ni sor brgyad nyid/ /ces dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ /de yi nang du sor mo brgyad/ /dor ba ru ni kha khyer bya/ /kun nas sor mo bzhi la ni/ /rin chen phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /zhes dang / rin chen 'bar ba las/ rgyas pa la ni sor mo brgyad/ /ces dang / pad can las/ gru bzhi pa la kha khyer yang / /snga ma nyis 'gyur tshad kyi 'o/ /zhes so/ /rgyas pa la sbyar ba bstan zin to/ /dbang la sbyar na dang po dbyibs ni/ dbang gi sogs te/ spyir khams gsum snod bcud kyis bsdus pa rnams dang / bye brag rang nyid ci 'dod pa de 'gugs par nus pas dbang zhes bya la/ de nyid sgrub pa'i thab khung ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum mtshon pas zla ba phyed pa dang 'dra bar gsungs te/ gur las/ dbang ni zla ba phyed pa 'dra/ /zhes dang / ye shes thig le las/ dbang ni gzhu yi rnam pa bzhin/ /zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ yang na zla phyed bzhin du gnas/ /zhes so/ /thab khung 'di la brten nas dgug pa'i las kyang bya bar gsungs te/ rtsa rgyud las/ dbang la ji ltar de bzhin dgug /ces dang / kha sbyor las/ dbang dang dgug pa thun mong ste/ /thab khung gcig pa'i mtshan nyid gsung / /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshad sogs te dbang gi thab 'di'i tshad ni/ rgyar khru 'di la dngos kha cig gis tshad drag po dang 'dra bar gsung pa ni gzhung 'dir tshad dang mu ran zhi ba dang 'dra la zhes dang / rin chen 'bar ba sogs kyi lung 'og nas 'byung ba dang dngos su 'gal lo/

/gang dang / zabs su khru phyed dang / de'i phyi rol du kha khyer mu ran sogs bzhi bzhi yod pa ni zhi ba dang 'dra ste/ a bha yas/ zab dang kha khyer la sogs pa'i tshad ni zhi ba'i thab khung bzhin shes par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /de'i zla gam byed tshul ni/ dang por thab kyi dngos gzhi khru gang ba bskor zin pa'i rjes su/ dbus nas shar gyi tshad thig la sor gsum/ 'phags pa'i rtags byas pa'i steng nas sngar gyi tshad de ma 'chugs par byas pa'i srad bu la/ slar sor gsum bsnan pas/ shar lho nas byang shar gyi bar dang / de'i phyi rol du kha khyer dang mu ran sor bzhi pa re shar gyi zur thig gnyis la reg par bskor zhing / de gsum gyi shar phyogs 'phred du bcad pas zla gam 'byung ngo / /de dag kyang rin chen 'bar ba las/ dbang dang dgug pa khru gang dang / /khru phyed rgya dang zabs su bstan/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ kha dog sogs te/ 'dir kha dog gi sgo nas mi mtshungs kyang dbyibs dang bya ba byed tshul gyi sgo nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor mtshon te/ rlung gi dngos po thams cad g.yo zhing dbang du byed pa ltar/ 'dis kyang bsgrub bya gang yin la rjes su chags pa'i sgo nas dbang du bsdud par byed la/ de'i kha dog ni dmar po ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ dbang la dmar po rab tu grags/ /zhes dang / kha sbyor las/ dbang la de bzhin dmar po ste/ /zhes dang / de nyid las/ dri ni dmar pos 'byug par bya/ /zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ thab khung dmar po dri dang ni/ /me tog gis ni so sor brgyan/ /zhes dang / pad can las/ sa dmar dang ni dri yis bya/ /zhes dang / yang thams cad gsang ba las/ skabs 'di dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i drag po'i dbyibs dang 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mtshon don bzlog nas gsungs pa ni/ rigs bdag gi dbang du mdzad pa ste/ de yang dbang gi rigs bdag me khams dag pa'i 'od dpag med/ drag po la rlung khams dag pa'i don yod grub pa yin pa la dgongs nas/

las de gnyis kyi thab khung yang 'byung ba de dag gi dbyibs ji lta bar gsungs pa ni/ rgyud sde'i khyad chos te/ rnam dbye 'di bzhin skabs gzhan du'ang shes dgos so/ /bzhi pa ni/ gong du bstan la/ lnga pa ni/ kha khyer sogs te/ 'di dag gi tshad ni bri tshul gyi skabs su bshad zin la/ 'on kyang kha khyer mu ran gang rung la lcags kyu'i 'phreng bas bskor ba'o/ /de dag kyang kha sbyor las/ zhi ba'i thab tshad bzhin du khung du ste zabs su thab khung de nyid kyi dang phyed/ /rgya'i tshad du khru gang dang / gzugs steng nang gi dbyibs zlum po/ mu ran kha khyer so bzhi bzhi/ byas nas ni/ /zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ zhi ba yi ni tshad bzhin du/ /'di yi kha khyer shes par bya/ /zhes dang / de nyid las/ rdo rje lcags kyu yis ni bskor/ /zhes dang / a bha yas/ thab khung gsum ka la yang gtso bo'i mtshan mas mtshan pa'i lcags kyus mtshan pa'o/ /zhes so/ /dbang la sbyar ba bstan zin to/ da ni drag po'i phyogs la brjod par bya ste/ dang po dbyibs ni/ drag po'i sogs te/ sngar smos pa'i las 'jam po gsum gyi rjes su gzung bar mi nus pa'i gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'i las yin pa'i phyir/ mngon spyod dam/ gdug pa'i las sam/ drag po zhes bya la/ de sgrub pa'i thab khung ni stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa ste/ rnam par mthar pa'i sgo gsum mtshon pas gru gsum dang ldan pa yin la/ thab khung 'dir bskrad pa sogs drag po'i bye brag gi las rnams kyang 'grub ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ bsad pa la ni gru gsum brjod/ /'di nyid la ni lhag ma sgrub/ /ces dang / gur las/ bsad dang zhe sdang las la ni/ /nam mkha'i khams dang mtshungs pa 'o/ /zhes dang / kha sbyor las/ mngon spyod thab khung gru gsum pa/ /zhes dang / ye shes thig le las/ drag po yis ni gru gsum mo/ /zhes dang /

rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ der ni thab khung gru gsum ste/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyar sogs te/ thab 'di'i rgyar sor mo nyi shu dang zabs su sor bcu dang ldan pa ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ sor mo nyi shu de yi phyed/ /bsad pa'i steng dang 'og tu yang / /zhes dang / kha sbyor las/ rgyar ni sor mo nyi shu ste/ /'og gi dpangs su sor mo bcu/ /zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ rgya ru sor mo nyi shu la/ /zabs su sor mo bcu tshad nyid/ /ces dang / rin chen 'bar ba las/ sor mo nyi shu de yi phyed/ rgya zabs bsad dang zhe sdang la'o/ /zhes dang / pad can las/ rgya dang rngams kyi tshad dag tu/ /sor ni nyi shu de yi phyed/ /bsad pa la ni thab khung 'di/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ kha dog sogs ste/ 'di yang kha dog gi sgo nas mi mtshungs mod/ dbyibs dang bya ba byed tshul gyis me'i dkyil 'khor mtshon te/ mes brtan g.yo thams cad bsreg par nus pa bzhin/ 'dis kyang spyir bstan pa dang sems can la 'tshe ba dang / khyad par las de'i dbang gis ma rung pa des dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myang bar rig nas/ de las skyabs pa'i phyir sbyor ba 'di gsungs shing / de'i kha dog kyang nag por bstan te/ rtsa rgyud las/ bsad pa la ni kha dog nag /ces dang / kha sbyor las/ bsad pa kha dog dag po ste/ /zhes dang / de nyid las/ dur khrod sol ba byug par bya//zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ sa nag dur khrod sol ba sogs/ /ji ltar rnyed pas nye bar byug /rin chen 'bar ba las/ gsod dang zhe sdang nag pa 'o/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ brjod zin la/ lnga pa ni/ kha khyer sogs te/ thab kyi dngos gzhi sor nyi shu par byas pa'i phyi rol du sor gsum bskyed pa kha khyer dang / de'i phyi nas sor gsum gyen du langs pa mu ran yin zhing / de nyid gang rung la rdo rje rtse gsum pa kha gdeng pas mtshan pa'o/ /de yang kha sbyor las/ mu ran la ni sor mo gsum/ /zhes dang /

rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ rtse gsum khro ba'i rdo rje ni/ /bcu drug phyed kyi sor tshad kyis/ /zhes dbus kyi mtshan ma dang thun mong du gsungs so/ /pad can las kyang / kha khyer sor mo gsum gyis bskor/ /zhes so/ /de ltar na thab kyi dbang du byas pa'i khyad par lnga yod pa las/ bzhi so sor sbyar nas bstan zin to/ de nas thab de bzhi ka'i sogs ni/ thab stegs yod pa'i dbang du mdzad nas de la 'god pa'i mtshan ma gsungs pa yin la/ stegs bu de dang der bkod pa'i mtshan ma ni skabs 'di'i rgyud gsum nas ma gsung pas nges pa can du mi dgos mod byed par spro na/ gzhan nas gsungs pa sbyar ba ste 'og tu gsal lo/ /gnyis pa las thams cad pa'i thab ni/ zhar las byung ba sogs te tshig gi don ni go bar zad cing / rin chen 'bar ba las/ 'byung zhes pa ni/ bstan bcos de las/ rang 'dod lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /las kun byed pa'i sbyin sreg ste/ /tshad dang dbyibs dang kha dog dag /zhi ba dang mthun shar blta 'o/ /zhes so/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs par ni de dang cung zad mi 'dra bar gsung ste ji skad du/ sa la las dang rjes mthun pa'i/ /thab khung las rnams thams cad pa/ /sngags pas ji lta ba bzhin bya/ /yang na yid ni gang dga' bar/ /khru gang zlum po kha khyer can/ /pad+ma rgyas pa lta bu 'o/ /kha khyer sor bzhi'i tshad tsam gyis/ /kha ni pad+ma rgyas pa 'dra/ /zhi ba bzhin du nang du dor/ /phyogs su rdo rjes mtshan pa ste/ /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ so so'i thab rdzogs par gsung pa'i rjes su/ 'on kyang las kun byed thabs kyi/ /khyad par zhi ba'i thab dang mtshungs/ /mchu ni pad+ma'i rnam pa ste/ /dma' ba rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor/ /zhes te/ snga ma las/ kha khyer sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang / phyi ma las/ mchu ni sogs rkang pa gnyis gsung pa'i don ni/ kha khyer pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar byas pa'i dbus kyi pad+ma'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i 'phreng pas brgyan pa yin no/

/de ltar las thams cad pa'i so so'i thab gang yin kyang phyi rol du dpangs su sor bzhi'i tshad can gyi stegs bu gru bzhi pa byas te/ sdom 'byung las/ de yi phyi rol kha khyer ni/ /gru bzhi mchu yi tshad la dpangs/ /zhes gsung la/ stegs bu de'i gru bzhir zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rjes mtshan pa ste/ gdan bzhi las/ zla phyed rdo rje shin tu mdzes/ /grwa dang grwa ru kun tu bzhag /ces so/ /yang kha sbyor las gsung pa'i las thams cad pa'i thab ni/ saṃ bu ṭa'i phyi ma la sogs te/ de'i thab ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni go bar zad la/ rgyud las gsung tshul ni/ thab khung zhes bya ba ni zlum po dang / gru bzhi dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / gru gsum mo zhes so/ /de ltar bshad pa'i thab rnams/ bru ba dang / bri ba'i phyogs ni 'di nyid kyi rgyud dgongs 'brel dang bcas pa nas gsal bar gsungs la/ brtsigs pa'i phyogs ni/ gshed dmar le'u bcu dgu pa las/ khru phyed brtsig bya zhi ba la/ /rgyas pa la ni khru gang ngo / /lnga gnyis bsad pa la bya ste/ /ji ltar dgugs pa de bzhin dbang / /zhes gsungs pas rung ba nyid yin no/ /de lta bu'i thab rnams kyi kha khyer dang mu ran dag ni/ las 'jam po gsum la rang rang gi thab dngos gzhi'i drug cha dang / drag po la rgyud nas sor gsum par gsal yang drug char byed pa'i tshe/ rgyud nas bshad pa'i steng du sor cig gam gsum cha re yod pa yin no/ /'di la gzhan nas thab kyi dngos gzhi sogs 'di dang 'dra ba la kha khyer mu ran lnga char bshad pa ni don dang ldan pa ma yin te/ de ni sor mo nyi shu la khru zhes pa ltar gzhal na tshad de 'jig par 'gyur te/ de yang zhi ba la mtshon na thab kyi dngos gzhi'i rgya la sor nyer bzhi dang / de'i kha khyer sogs sor bzhi par bshad pa'i kha khyer sogs lnga cha yin na/ thab dngos gzhi la sol nyi shu las med pa'i kha khyer sogs sor lnga par 'gyur bas so/

de lta mod kyi 'on kyang gdan bzhi dang sdom 'byung sogs las/ kha khyer rang rang gi thab kyi brgyad char bshad pa yang yod pas skyon med do zhe na/ des ni mi 'grub ste/ rgyud de dag las kha khyer la sor grangs med par thab kyi dngos gzhi gang yin pa de nyid dum bu brgyad du byas pa'i cha re yod ces pa'i don yin te/ gdan bzhi las/ brkos pa yis ni brgyad cha yis/ /khung bu yis ni kha gyer bya/ /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ thab khung gis ni brgyad cha yis/ /mchu ni de nyid du bya ste/ /zhes gsungs la/ de dag gi mu ran yang / rgyud gnyis po las rim pa bzhin/ kha khyer gyis ni phyed cha yis/ /phyi rol gyi ni mu ran bya/ /zhes dang / mchu yi phyed kyi cha yis ni/ /zhes sogs gsung pas so/ /de'i phyir 'di ni yig mkhan blun po zhig gi zhe 'dod brtse ba chen pa'i gsung rab la sbyar bar zad de/ brtse chen de ni rgyud dang 'gal ba mi gsung pa'i phyir ro/ /yang skabs 'dir zhi ba'i thab khung bri ba'i phyogs ston pa'i dpe rnying rnams las/ kha dog 'dres pa'i skyon spang pa'i phyir bcad tshon thams cad rdo rje'i kha dog dmar skyas bya/ zhes byung ba la dpyad pa gtan ma mdzad par/ mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub kyis kyang de bzhin gsung mod 'di la rnam par brtag na/ kha dog 'dres pa'i skyon yod par dogs pa de ni gzhi med yin te/ 'di'i kha dog dkar po kho na yin pas so/ /gal te de nyid 'dres par dogs pas shod ce na/ de 'dres pa la skyon ci zhig yod kyang bshad dgos la/ dogs pa de kho na spong ba'i phyir yin na ni/ thab khung brus pa dang brtsigs pa la yang de ltar byed dgos pas/ ngal ba 'bras bu med par 'gyur ro/ /'o na ji ltar yin snyam na/ brus pa dang brtsigs pa'i thab la ni ji tar skad bshad pa'i dbyibs dang tshad rnams dngos su tshang bar byed nus la/ bri ba'i phyogs la de bzhin du mi 'byung bas rnam pa dang kha khyer sogs kyi grangs tshang ba tsam ston pa'i phyir yin no/

/dgos pa de ni dkar po nyid kyis byas kyang 'grub pas na/ deng sang dmar skyas byed pa ni mig sngar mdzes pa tsam mang du zad do/ de bzhin du gzhan gsum la'ang shes par bya'o/ /da ni dkyus ma nyid 'chad pa la gzhung 'dir mi 'byung yang / thams cad kyi thun mong du 'jug pa me yol zhes bya ba sgrub pa po dang thab kyi bar du 'jim pa dkar po'am/ so phag sogs las byas pa la dkar rtsis byugs pa rgyar theb sor bcu gnyis dang / dpangs su mi sked tsam slebs pa zhig byas la/ de nyid dngos gzhi'i tshe ri bo gangs can du bsgom pas bdag gi tshad gdung sogs sel bar bsam ste/ gdan bzhi las/ ji bzhin bstan pa'i gnas su yang / /mtheb sor bcu gnyis dag dang ni/ /dpangs su skyes bu phyed ldan pa'i/ /te sa'i gangs ri mdzes par bzhag /ces so/ /'di la kha cig las dang mthun pa'i kha dog tu byed na ni/ rgyus chung la ham pa che bas rang gzhan nyams nga bar byed pa ste/ gangs ri la kha dog gzhan mi rigs pas so/ /'o na khyod kyi bshad pa las bzhi'i thun mong du 'jug par gang las shes snyam na/ rgyud de nyid zhi ba sogs kyi bya ba gzhan rnams rdzogs par bstan pa'i rjes su 'di gsung pa dang / 'di nyid kyi dgos pa las kyang shes te/ me lha ni 'jig rten pa'i tshul 'dzin pa yin la/ de spyan drangs pa na/ de'i rjes su 'brangs zhing mes mi gnod pa'i 'byung po rang rgyud pa du ma 'ong nas/ sgrub pa po la 'tshe bar byed pa'i tshe/ 'di nyid gang 'dir bsgom pas gnod pa des mi tshugs pa'i ched yin no/ /des na skabs 'dir me yol med pa'i phyogs la slob dpon a bha yas/ de dang lhan cig lhags pa'i bgegs thams cad gshin rje gshed la sogs pas bskrad nas/ zhes gsung pa yang legs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bud shing la bzhi las/ dang po ni/ zhi ba la sogs te/ de'i bud shing ni/ sangs rgyas thod pa las/ a shwa ka dang n+ya gro dha/ /u duṃ wa ra sarka ti/

/pa la sha ste shing rnam lnga/ /zhes gsungs pa'i 'o ma shing gi rtse mo'i cha las byung ba ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ mchod sbyin shing las byung ba yi/ /bud shing thab khung ring thung tshad/ /ces dang / gdan bzhi las/ yam shing thang shing las byas sam/ /zho can lnga yi shing las bya/ /zhes dang / nag po pas/ yal ga'i rtse mo'i cha las byung / /bud shing zhi ba'i las la 'dod/ /ces so/ /'di gdan bzhi las/ yam shing zhes pa drangs pa ni/ 'og yam shing gi skabs kyi shes byed du 'dug pas 'chol bar 'gyur ro/ /zhe na/ skyon med de/ rgyud dang bstan bcos gzhan nas kyang de bzhin du 'byung zhing / de yang bud shing yam shing dag rgyu gcig yin pas ming de gnyis gang smos kyang rung ba la dgongs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang shes dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyas pa'i sogs te/ de'i bud shing ni/ kha dog ser zhing dri zhim pa 'bras bu bzang po dang bcas pa'i shing gi dbus kyi cha las byung ba ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ 'bras bur bcas pa'i shing sngon bzhin/ /rgyas pa'i las la bsreg par bya/ /zhes dang / nag po pas/ yal ga'i dbus kyi cha las byung / /bud shing rgyas pa'i las la 'o/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ dbang la sogs te/ de la ni kha dog shin tu dmar zhing ro'i bye brag skyur po dang ldan pa'i rtse mo'i cha las byung ba ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ dri med rab dmar 'bras bur bcas/ /ljon shing dri ma med pa yis/ /zhes dang / a bha yas/ dbang du bya ba la ni/ nim pa dngas shing skyur po dang gzhan yang me tog dang ldan pas bya'o/ /zhes so/ /gal te dbang rgyas gnyis la ji skad bshad pa'i bud shing de dag ma rnyed na/ sngar bshad pa'i 'o ma can gyi shing rnams kyis byas pas rung ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ yam shing zhi ba bzhin du gzung / /zhes dang / de bzhin du gzhan las kyang 'byung ngo / /ci ste na yul dus kyi dbang gis de yang ma 'byor na/

rnga mo sogs ma yin pa'i nags tshal sogs/ dben pa'i phyogs kyi lci ba skam po srog chags med pa dang / gzhan yang tsher ma can ma yin pa shing 'byor pa dang mthun pas bya ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ dgon pa yi ni lci ba yang / /'bu srin yongs su spangs pa dang / /zhes dang / pad can las/ ji ltar 'byor pas rnyed pa'i yam shing la sogs pa/ zhes so/ /'di ni 'og nas 'byung ba'i drag po la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de ltar na a bha yas/ rgyas pa la ni/ dgon pa'i ba glang gi lci ba ma gtogs pa'i ji skad bshad pa'i bud shing 'bras bu dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes bshad cing / gzhan las kyang de bzhin du 'byung ba dang 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te lugs de dag gi nyams len gyi tshe de ltar byed pa la bkag cing / 'dir ni pad can las/ rgyas pa'i skabs nyid du/ ji skad gsung pa'i bud shing ni/ sngon bzhin gzhan du lci ba yang / /zhes gsung pas so/ /bzhi pa ni/ drag po la sogs te/ 'dir ni kha dog nag cing dri mi zhim pa dbyibs 'khyog po tsher ma dang bcas pa'i yang rtsa ba'i cha las byung ba dang / gzhan yang rnga mo dang / bong bu'i sbangs la sogs pa ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ sdang la sogs par tsher mar brjod/ /ces dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ dug sogs tsha ba tsher ma dang / /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ tsher ma'i me ni rab sbar la/ /zhes dang / nag po pas/ yal ga'i rtsa ba chu las 'byung / /bud shing mngon spyod las la 'o/ /zhes dang / a bha yas/ mngon spyod la ni/ kha ba dang / tsha ba dang / tsher ma can dang / dri nga ba dang / dri med pa dang / bung bu dang rnga mo'i sbangs sam/ shing shin tu skam pas so/ /zhes so/ /de nas gzhan yang sogs zhar las byung ba kha sbyor gyi rgyud sogs la kha 'phangs ni de bzhin du bya ba yin pas/ 'dir yang mang ba'i 'jigs pas ma bkrol lo/ /gsum pa sbar ba'i me la yang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ zhi ba la sogs te/ bram ze rnams kyi sbyin sreg rgyun par byas pa las byung ba'i me'am/

gong du bstan pa'i shing 'o ma can nam/ tsan+dan dkar po las byung ba'i mes bya ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ bsrubs pa las ni byung me 'am/ /gnyis skyes la sogs las rjes mthun/ /zhes dang / nag po pas/ zhi ba la ni dgon me 'am/ /bram ze tha mal pa yi me/ /zhes dang / a bha yas zhi ba la 'o ma can dang / rtsub shing las byung ba'i me dang / dgon pa'i me dang / sbyin sreg gi me yang rung ngo / /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyas pa la sogs te/ de la ni dge 'dun gyi bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen lnga me/ gdan/ phrug bskyed/ khrus khung dang / khye'u sus te rnam lnga'o/ /bstan pa'i khang pa ni bsro khang ste de las byung ba'i 'am/ rgyal po'i g.yos khang nas byung ba'i 'am/ me shel sogs rin po che las byung ba'i 'am/ nags tshal tshigs pa las byung ba'i mes bya ste/ nag po pas/ rgyas pa la ni rgyal rigs sam/ /rje rigs las byung me yis bya/ /zhes dang / a bha yas/ rgyas pa la rgyal po'i rgyal rigs las byung ba'i dang / nags mes tshigs pa'i dang / nor bu las byung ba'i dang / dge 'dun gyi tshwa khang las byung ba'i mes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ dbang la sogs te/ rang gi bdag po yod dam/ med kyang rung skyes pa du ma dbang du bsdud pa'i bud med kyi khyim gyi'am/ sprang po sogs kyi lam du bus pa'i mes bya ste/ nag po pas/ dbang dang dgug pa smad pa 'am/ /lam du byung ba'i me yis bya/ /zhes dang / pad can las/ smad tshong me la mnyam bzhag pas/ /zhes dang / a bha yas/ dbang la smad tshong ma'i mes bya'o/ /dbang gi dgug pa la yang gar mkhan gyi rol mo mkhan dang mgron pos bus pa'i mes so/ /zhes bshad do/ /dbang rgyas gnyis la so so'i me rnams ma rnyed na zhi ba'i skabs kyi mes kyang rung ste/ kha sbyor las/ rtsub pa las ni byung ba'i mes/ /dge byed las ni byed par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ drag po la sogs te/ 'gro ba du ma'i gshed mar gyur pa bshan pa'i khyim gyi'o/

/rdo dang lcags rtsub pa las byung ba'i 'am/ dur khrod kyi me la sogs pas bya ste/ kha sbyor las/ gdol pa'am dur khrod skyes pas ni/ /mi dge byed pa rab tu bsgrub/ /ces dang / nag po pas/ mngon spyod la ni gdol pa 'am/ /rdo las byung ba'i me yis kyang / /zhes dang / a bha yas/ drag po la ni/ mi ro dur khrod du bsregs pa'i 'am/ rdo dang gdol pa'i khyim las byung ba'i mes so/ /zhes bshad do/ /de ltar bshad pa'i me rnams sbyor ba'i skabs 'dir rang rang gi snod du 'dus byas pa yi ge gsum gyis bsrungs nas 'jog par yang bshad do/ /pad can las/ yi ge 'bru gsum gyis bsrung ba'i/ /mi ni snod du bzhag par bya/ /zhes so/ bzhi pa bsreg rdzas la yang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ zhi ba la sogs te 'di'i yam shing gi rgyu ni sngar bshad pa'i 'o ma can rnams yin la/ de'i tshad ni sbom du mthe'u chung ngam mthe bong gi tshad tsam dang / dkyus su khu tshur gnyis brtsegs pa'i sor brgyad dang ldan par bya ste/ kha sbyor las/ de nyid kyi yam shing du brjod pa ste 'on kyang khu tshur gyi tshad dang / zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyas la sogs te/ 'dir yang rgyu ni sngar gyi kha dog ser ba sogs dang ldan pa de yin la/ tshad ni sbom du phyag gang ba ste/ mthe bong tsam dang / dkyus su khru gang yod par bya ste/ kha sbyor las/ khru gang tsam gyi tshad 'o ma dang mar la btags te/ zhes dang / nag po pas/ rgyas pa la ni khru gang / zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ dbang la sogs te/ 'di'i rgyu yang gong du bshad pa'i kha dog dmar ba sogs dang ldan pa'i shing de'o/ /yang na rgyu dang tshad sogs zhi ba dang 'dra bar byas pas rung ste/ kha sbyor las skabs 'dir/ u dum wa ra la sogs pa'i shing rnams byung ba sor brgyad pa dang / zhes dang / nag po pas/ dbang dang dgug pa zhi dang 'dra/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ drag po la sogs te/ 'dir yang rgyu ni/ gong du bstan pa'i kha dog nag pa sogs dang ldan pa la/

tshad ni sbom phra ji ltar rig pa'i dkyus su sor bcu pa yin zhing / de yang rtse mo rno ba khrag dang / dur khrod kyi thal ba dang / dug sogs kyi byugs pas bya ste/ kha sbyor las/ khrag dang lhan cig shing nag po 'khyor po las skyes pa'i tsher ma dang / tsha ba dang / kha ba la sogs pa'i shing thams cad las skyes pa'i sor bcu pa dang / zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ rtse rnon dug la sogs pa yi/ /de yi gnyis ka cha sbags pa/ /gdug pa'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /zhes dang / nag po pas/ mngon spyod la ni sor bcu 'o/ /zhes dang / /pad can las/ kha ba tsha ba tsher ma rnams/ /yam shing la ni thal bas 'byug /ces so/ /de ltar bshad pa'i yam shing gi tshad la sogs pa rnams ni yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud gtso bor mdzad nas gsungs pa yin la/ rgyud gzhan dang mi thub zla ba yab sras la sogs pas ni/ bud shing dang yam shing gnyis ka'i rgyu 'o ma can gyi shing rnams las bzhi ka'i thun mong du byas nas/ tshad rnams so sor bshad de/ ji skad du/ legs grub las/ 'o ma can gyi shing dag gis/ /me la yam shing mtho gang tsam/ /'o ma sbrang rtsi mar btags te/ /zhi ba'i las la bsreg par bya/ /zhes dang / nag po pas/ mchod sbyin la sogs shing las byung / /yam shing sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /zhes dang / legs bsdud las/ mchod sbyin shing gi lcug ma yi/ /rtse mo'i cha ni ma nyams pa/ /bzang po lo ma gnyis ldan pa/ /las kyi dbye bas dbye bar bya/ /rgyas pa la ni sor bcu bzhi/ /zhi ba sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /dbang la sor bcu sdang ba dang / /bskrad pa la yang sor mo brgyad/ /ces dang / de ji lta bar rin chen 'bar ba las kyang gsungs so/ /de nas mchod rdzas la sogs pa bshad par bya ba la de dag gi snod ni/ 'byor na las dang rjes su mthun pa'i rin po che'i dang / de ltar mi 'grub pa rnams kyis ji ltar 'byor pa'i snod du bya ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/

gser dang dngul gyi rang bzhin nam/ yang na dung dang nya phyis sam/ /zangs ma 'khar ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /rdza las byas pa'i rang bzhin nam/ /tha mar 'dab ma'i snod kyang rung / /kun tu 'byor dang rjes mthun pa'i/ /mchod pa'i snod ni shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /der bsham bya'i mchod pa ni/ mchod rdzas sogs te/ de la yang las so so'i ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ 'o ma me tog dam pa dang / /rab tu ldan pa'i spos kyis bdug /de yi rang sngags lan bdun bzlas/ /zhes zhi ba'i dang / ser po'i dri sogs ldan pa'i chu/ /til dang bcas shing zho yis brgyan/ /rang gi sngags kyis mngon sngags pa/ /rgyas pa yis ni mchod yon no/ /zhes rgyas pa'i dang / dri dmar la sogs sa yi chu/ /gang zhig me tog kun tu dmar/ /dga' ba'i don du 'di gsungs te/ /zhes dbang gi dang / dri nga'i dri dang ldan pa'i chu/ dog nag pa las skyes dang ldan/ /ko ṭa pa dang ba lang chu/ /yang na mi yi chu nyid dam/ /bong bu yi ni chu yang rung / /phaṭa la sogs pas mngon sngags te/ /zhes pa drag po'i 'o/ /gzhan yang me tog la sogs pa zhi drag gi khyad par gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bsham mo/ /gal te so so'i mchod pa khyad par ba rnams ma rnyed na rin chen 'bar ba sogs las 'byung ba'i chu bzhi nyer spyod dang bcas pa dang / gtor ma gnyis rnams 'du bya ba yin no/ /de nas sreg rdzas sogs te/ de yang las bzhi'i thun mong gi sreg rdzas ni/ rin chen 'bar ba las/ 'bras so ma chag 'bras dang ni/ /'bru dang zho yi zan dang ni/ /til dang de bzhin mnyam pa'i shing / /dur ba rab tu gzhon pa nyid/ /ces pa rnams yin la/ khyad par so so'i grangs 'dzin pa'i rdzas ne zhi la til dang / rgyas pa la zas mchog sogs dang / dbang la me tog dmar po'i 'bras drug cu pa sogs dang / drag po la dug dang tsha ba gsum la sogs pa ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ zhi ba til dang rgyas pa zho/ /bsad la tsher ma de bzhin no/

/sdang la sogs pa'ang tsher mar brjod/ /dbang dang dgug pa ut+pal/ /zhes so/ /de ltar bshad pa'i mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams ni/ las dang mthun pa'i kha dog tu bsgyur ba'am bsam par bya'o/ /de yang rin chen 'bar ba las/ me tog la sogs rdzas rnams ni/ /las kyi dbye bas kha dog dbye/ /dkar po zhi bar byed par brjod/ /ser po rgyas pa'i sgrub thabs la/ /dbang dang dgug pa dmar po che/ /tha ma'i las la nag pa 'o/ /lnga pa bsham thabs la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ las 'jam po sogs te/ de la don dam par phyogs kyi dbye ba med kyang kun rdzob tu las bzhi gang la zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i kha gang du blta pa'i phyogs te shar du bya ba yin te/ a bha yas/ 'dir yang sgrub pa po gang la mngon par phyogs pa la ltos nas shar la sogs pa'i tha snyad du bya ste/ don dam par shar la sogs pa'i phyogs med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du gzhan las kyang 'byung ngo / /'di ni kha blta phyogs bshad pa'i skabs su yang dran par bya'o/ /de ltar de na las 'jam po gsum la rnal 'byor pa'i g.yas phyogs su yam shing sogs sreg rdzas dang g.yon du mchod rdzas rnams bsham mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ drag po la sogs te/ las de bsgrub pa la ni snga ma las bzlog nas mchod rdzas g.yas dang / sreg rdzas g.yon du dang / thams cad la yang mdun du mchod yon gyi snod dang rdo dril dgang blugs dang bcas pa bshams te/ kha sbyor las/ sbyin sreg yo byad g.yas su bzhag g.yon du chu yi snod/ mdun du mchod yon snod nyid do/ /zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ g.yon du chu yi snod bzhag ste/ /sbyin sreg yo byad g.yas su'o/ /zhes de nyid las/ drag po'i mchod yon bstan pa'i rjes su/ gdug pa'i las ni bya ba'i phyir/ /g.yas kyi phyogs su bzhag par bya/ /zhes dang / grub chen nyi ma sbas pas/ dgang gzar blugs gzar rdo rje dril/ /rnal 'byor mdun du bzhag par bya/

/zhes so/ /drug pa sgrub po'i khyad par las/ /bsam pa dus dang blta phyogs dang / /rgyan dang chas gos 'dug stangs dang / /zhar las byung ba dgang blugs so/ /zhes pa ltar drug gi dang po lnga ni las bzhi so so la sbyar bar bya ba yin pas zhi ba'i dbang du byas na/ dang po ni/ sdig pa sogs te/ de dang sogs kyis bsdus pa nad rims dang cho ga'i skabs kyi lhag chad sogs zhi bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas bya ste/ gur las/ zhi ba'i sems kyis zhi ba ste/ /nad la sogs pa zhi bar bya/ /zhes dang / kha sbyor las/ zhi ba la zhi ba'i yid dang / zhes so/ /gnyis pa dus ni srod kyi sogs te/ de dang phyi ma red dam ste/ dgong ka'i dus su bya ste/ mi thub zla ba yab sras kyis/ zhi ba dgong ka bya ba ste/ /zhes dang / nag po pas/ zhi ba phal cher srod la bya/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ kha shar du sogs te kha blta phyogs 'di ni/ las bzhi ka phyogs bdag ltos nas blta bar bshad pas 'dir dbang pos mi mthun phyogs zhi bar byed la de phyogs su kha bltas pas/ las 'di 'grub slab la dgongs nas rgyud dang bstan bcos phal cher las zhi ba la shar du blta bar gsungs te/ kha sbyor las/ zhi bar 'dod pas kha shar du bltas shing / zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ zhi ba don gnyer dpa' bos ni/ /snying rjer ldan pas shar bltas te/ /zhes dang / gsang 'dus las/ shar du kha bstan zhi ba la/ zhes dang / bstan bcos gzhan las/ srod la shar du kha bltas 'gyur/ /zhes dang / a bha yas/ srod la shar du kha bltas la blos sgrub par bya ba dmigs nas/ zhes sogs mang du 'byung ngo / /yang sangs rgyas thod pa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi/ rdo rje phreng ba sogs rgyud 'ga' zhig dang / mi thub zla ba yab sras sogs bstan bcos kha cig la/ zhi ba la byang dang rgyas pa shar du blta bar gsungs pa ni/ phyogs de dag gi skabs de'i khyad chos yin pas/ phan tshun bsre bar mi bya'o/ /'o na legs bsdu sogs 'di rang gi gzhung ma yin nam zhe na/

yin mod kyi 'on kyang bstan bcos de dag gi cho ga'i yan lag rnams gdan bzhi sogs las btus par bshad pas 'gal ba cung zad kyang med do/ /bzhi pa ni/ rgyan dang sogs te/ las kyi kha dog dang mthun par shel la sogs pa'i rgyan dang / dar ram ras sogs kyi gos dkar po dang ldan pas bya ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ gos dkar la sogs rgyan dang ldan/ /zhes dang / a bha yas/ byams pa'i sems dang ldan pas gos dkar po gyon te/ zhes sogs/ lnga pa ni/ tsog pu'i sogs te/ 'di ni phyi rol pa dag sbyin sreg gi tshe tsog pur 'dug nas byed pa de drangs ba'i phyir de dang mthun pa'am/ yang na pad+ma'i skyil krung du gnas pas bya ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ 'jam pa'i bstan gyi dbus gnas te/ /zhi bas pad+ma'i 'dug stangs dang / /zhes dang / a bha yas/ 'jam zhing shin tu bde ba'i bstan la pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis 'dug la/ zhes so/ /da ni rgyas pa'i phyogs la brjod na/ dang po ni/ tshe dang sogs te/ cho ga 'di la brten nas rang gzhan gyi tshe dang bsod nams sogs phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgyas pa'i ched du yid dga' zhing tshim pa'i bsam pas bya ste/ gur las/ rgyas pa'i sems kyis rgyas pa ste/ /rin chen char sprin rab skor bya/ /zhes dang / kha sbyor las/ rgyas pa la sogs pa tshim pa dang 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhan nas bzlog ste bshad pa yod kyang 'dir snga dro'i dus su bya ste/ mi thub zla ba yab sras kyis/ rgyas pa nang par bya ba yin/ /zhes dang / nag po pas/ rgyas pa snga dro bya bar bshad/ /ces dang / a bha yas/ snga dro nas brtsams te rgyas pa'i las bya'o/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ kha byang du sogs te rnam thos bu dgos 'dod mtha' yas pa la dbang bsgyur zhing gnas pa'i phyogs su bltas na grub sla bas byang du blta bar bya ste/ kha sbyor las/ kha byang du bltas shing gnas nas/ zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/

byang du kha bltas dga' ldan te/ /zhes dang / a bha yas/ dga' ba'i yid kyis byang du bltas nas/ zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ rgyan gos sogs te/ 'dir yang las dang mthun pa'i rgyan dang gos sogs ser pos brgyan par bya ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ ser po rgyan byas snga dro ni/ /nor gyi 'phang na rgyas pa bya/ /zhes dang / pad can las/ phreng ba gos ni ser po ldan/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ bzang po'i sogs te/ de yang bstan mtho ba'i steng du 'dug nas/ rkang pa sa la bzhag pa bzang po'i 'dug stangs dang / skyil krung las rkang pa g.yas cung zad brkyangs pa rgyal po rol pa'i tshul zhes pa gang rung gi gnas pa bya ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis 'dug ste/ /yang na rgyal po rol pas so/ /zhes dang / a bha yas/ bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis 'dug la/ zhes so/ /da ni dbang gi phyogs la bshad par bya ba la/ dang po ni/ rgyal po sogs te/ de nyid gtso bor gyur pa'i skye 'gro thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gnas la dgongs pa sogs kyi phyir bdag gi dbang du bsdu ba'i bsam pas bya ste/ gur nas 'byung ba'i don rin chen 'bar ba las/ rjes su chags pa'i sems kyis ni/ /dgug pa'i las ni yang dag brtsam/ /zhes dang / kha sbyor las/ dbang la dbang gi yid mnyes par byed cing rnam par 'khrul pa dang / zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyin ma red sogs te/ 'di ni gong du thab kyi tshad sogs zhi ba dang 'dra bar bshad pa'i rigs pa dang / nag po pas/ dbang ni dgong gi dus su 'o/ /zhes gsung pa la brten par snang la/ gzhan las ni mtshan phyed la bya bar bshad pa mang ste/ legs bsdus las/ mtshan mo phyed na dbang sogs bya/ /zhes dang / rin chen 'bar ba las/ dbang dang dgug pa mtshan phyed la/ /zhes dang / rgyud dag las kyang / dbang gi las ni mtshan phyed kyi/ /zhes dang / dbang dang mngon spyod dag gi las/ /nyi ma gung dang mtshan phyed la 'o/ /zhes so/

/gsum pa ni/ kha dog sogs te/ 'di ni klu rnams kyi zhags pas 'dod bya dbang du byed cing / de'i rten 'brel gyis myur du 'grub pa la dgongs nas kha nub tu blta bar gsungs te/ kha sbyor las/ kha nub tu bltas te zhes dang / legs bsdus las/ dbang la nub tu bshad pa yin/ /zhes dang / rin chen 'bar ba las/ dbang dang dgug pa nub tu 'o/ /zhes dang / a bha yas/ kha nub tu bltas shing / zhes so//bzhi pa ni/ rgyan dang gos sogs ni dmar pos brgyan par bya te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ chags shing gos ni dmar pos brgyan/ /zhes dang / pad can las/ 'dir ni dpal ldan gos dmar bgo /zhes dang / de nyid las/ chags pas de bzhin dmar pos brgyan/ /zhes dang / a bha yas/ rgyan dmar po la sogs pas brgyan la/ zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ pad+ma'i sogs te/ 'dir gsungs pa ni/ rigs kyi dbang du byas par snang la/ de ltar na zhi ba'i tshe rdo rje skyil krung du don gyis thob bo/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro las ni/ gong du bstan pa bzhin zhi ba la pad+ma'i skyil krung dang / 'dir sems dpa'i skyil krung du bshad/ ji skad du/ sems dpa'i skyil krung yang dag gnas/ /zhes so/ /'dir a bha yas/ lha'i skyil krung gis 'dug ste/ /zhes bshad pa ni/ rdo rje skyil krung yin par mngon te/ skabs 'dir pad can las/ de nyid rdo rje'i skyil krung gis/ /dmar po'i stan ni mtho la 'dug /ces dang / mthun pas so snyam mo/ /da ni drag po'i phyogs la brjod na/ dang po ni/ dgra dang sogs te/ 'dir ni yul cung zad gsal bar bshad na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed dang / /ma rung dam tshig nyams pa la/ /zhes dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed las/ slob dpon smod par byed pa dang / /theg pa chen por bskur ba dang / /sngags dang rgyud sbyor ye shes la/ /'phya bar byed pa'i mi gang ni/ /zhes sogs rgyud rnams las/ du ma zhig gsung pa'i gdug can bstan pa rin po che dang /

sems can rnams kyi gshed mar gyur pa de dang de lta bu ni/ sngags pa snying rje'i dbang du gyur pa'i blo gros can yul de'i sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' rtogs pa'i mngon shes dang ldan pas/ ma rung pa de re zhig tshar gcod kyi sgo nas bsad cing / phyis rjes 'dzin gyi sgo nas rnam shes bkug te rten de nyid la bcug nas gso ba'am/ yang na bsad pa'i rjes thogs su dag pa'i zhing du skyel nus pas bya ste/ rdo rje 'jigs byed las/ dkon mchog gsum la gnod par byed pa dang / dam tshig dang bral ba dang / sngags dang rgyud la 'phya bar byed pa dang / sems can la 'tshe ba 'di rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ sngags pa snying rjes gdung ba'i sems can gyis gnod pa'i sbyor ba bya'o/ /kye ma don 'di lta bu ma rtogs par/ deng sang theg pa chen po spyi bye brag gi zhal ngo 'dzin par rlom pa dag tshe 'di'i snang ba mig rgyu lta bus bslu bar ma shes pas/ de'i tshe thabs sgrub pa'i phyir lus srog kyang btang zhing / rang gces par 'dzin pa'i gdon gyi dbang du gyur pas/ thog ma med pa nas drin gyis bskyangs pa'i pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams la mi dge ba'i las sbyor sna tshogs byed pa ni/ sems can rnams la byams pa spangs/ /bzhi pa yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes dang / chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /de spong ba ni lnga pa yin/ /zhes pa 'di dag gi don rtogs pa lta ci smos/ thos pa'i yul du yang ma gyur par zad do/ /yang de dag gi cha tsam thos shing don yang 'ol ji tsam go bzhin du/ sbyor rtsub sna tshogs nyams su len pa ni/ sbrul gdug pas 'o ma 'thung pa ltar zab lam mi dge ba'i gsos su gyur pa yin la/ de dag gis ni sngon nas 'phangs pa'i tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gags ma thag tu dmyal ba la sogs pa'i bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur te/ rdo rje 'jigs byed las/ gal te sngags pa rmongs pa'i bdag nyid kyis byed na dmyal bar nges par lhung ngo /

/zhes dang / de nyid las gal te gzhan la byas na dam tshig nyams nas tsha ba chen por 'gro'o/ /zhes so/ /de ltar na rgyud rnams las mngon spyod kyi cho ga ji snyed gsungs pa'i don ci zhe na/ de dag la drangs pa'i don yin la/ 'ga' zhig ni bshad ma thag pa ltar yul dus gnas skabs shes shing nus ldan gyi bya rung ba la dgongs kyi ci dgar bya ba ma yin no/ /de'i phyir theg pa chen po'i lam la zhugs pa'i rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis lam der zhugs pa'i dgos pa dang / sems can gnod pa tsam gyis ni/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub rnyed mi 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dri ma med pa'i lung rnams thugs la bzhag nas/ gang dag 'dod pa'i dbang phyug snying la tshangs pa'i skyes ngan gyi rjes su mi 'brang bar/ drin can pha ma rnams la 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor spangs nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la bkod pa'i phyir brtson par mdzad du gsol ba snying nas 'debs so/ /da ni kyus ma nyid 'chad pa ni/ gong du bstan pa bzhin yul dus sogs nges pa'i tshe/ khro bo'i lus kyi gzugs ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas 'phrin las byed pa'i mgon/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ shin tu gdug pa'i gtum po la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo yis/ /khro bor de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad/ /ces gsung pa dang mtshungs par bsam pa drag cing sbyor ba rtsub pa ltar bstan nas gdug pa can de rjes su 'dzin pa'i bsam pas bya ste/ gur las/ gdug pa'i sems kyis bsad pa ste/ /me yi char sprin dbab par bya/ /zhes dang / kha sbyor las/ mngon spyod la hūm̐ phaṭa kyi lus 'bar zhing 'bar ba dang 'jig rten gsum za ba'i sems kyis gnas so/ /zhes dang / pad can las/ khros pa'i sems kyi bskrod par byed de/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ nam phyed sogs te/ 'di la ni mtshan phyed dang nyin phyed la mi mthun pa med pa la de gnyis ni gang rung la byas pas 'grub ste/

rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ mtshan mo phyed dang nyin phyed na/ /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ drag po'i las ni nyin phyed dam/ /mtshan phyed na ste gdol po'i mer/ /zhes dang / legs bsdus las/ gdug pa'i las ni nyin phyed la/ /zhes dang / rin chen 'bar ba las/ mtshan phyed bsad dang zhe sdang la'o/ /zhes dang / /nyi ma gung dang nam phyed la/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ kha sogs ste/ lho phyogs na gshin rjes nyes pa can mtha' dag tshar gcod cing gnas la/ de'i phyogs su kha bltas pas las 'di 'grub sla ba la dgongs pa ste/ kha sbyor las/ mnyam par bzhag pas kha lhor bltas te/ zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ gdug pas lho ru kha bltas ste/ /zhes dang / legs bsdus las/ mngon spyod la ni lho ru ste/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ rgyan dang sogs te/ las kyi dbye bas brgyan dang gos nag po la/ dur khrod kyi thal ba dang ro sol dang khrag dang dug la sogs pa drag rdzas ji snyed byugs pa gyon nas bya ba'am/ gcer bu lus la thal bas byugs nas bya ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ gos nag rgyan gyis brgyan pa yis/ /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ lho phyogs kha bltas gcer pu 'am/ /sngags pas gos ni nag po gyon/ /zhes dang / pad can las/ khrag chu yis ni gsher ba'i ras/ /yang na sngon po'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /zhes dang / a bha yas/ rgyan dang gos sngon po'am/ yang na khrag gi chus gsher ba'i gos sngon po bgos te/ zhes so/ /'di ni spyi rgyud las kyang gsal bar gsung ste/ sngon spyod gos ni nag po la/ /khrag gi btab pas bya ba yin/ /yang na gos rnying dri ma can/ /bgo 'am gcer pur gnas pas brtsam/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ bstan med pa'am sogs te/ sngar bshad pa'i rgyan sogs dang ldan pas bstan med pa'am/ yang na rdo la sogs pa shin tu 'khregs pa'i stan la ro sol gyis nag por bsgyur ba'i steng du/ rkang pa g.yas pa g.yon pas mnan pa'am/ yang na g.yon pa cung zad brkyangs shing g.yas bskum pa khro bo'i skyil krung gis 'dug la rus pa dang /

rdo ba dang nim pa'i 'dab ma la sogs pa 'cha' bzhin pa'am/ so'i sgra drag po 'debs shing rab tu khros pa'i rnam 'gyur dang ldan pas bya ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ khro bo'i skyil krung rab gnas pas/ /sra ba'i stan la gnas nas ni/ /zhes dang / pad can las/ sra ba'i stan la gshin rje ltar/ /rus pa rdo ba nim pa'i 'dab/ /'cha' bar byed cing khro gnyer gdong / /zhes dang / a bha yas/ rkang pa g.yas pa g.yon pas mnan cing so 'cha' ba dang bcas pa'i mig bgrad pa dang / bzhin khro gnyer canasnying rje chen po dang ldan pas/ zhes so/ /yang yul phyogs kyi rims nad sel ba'i phyir ram/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na grong khyer ram/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i shar du zhi ba/ lhor drag po/ nub tu dbang / byang du rgyas pa rnams sngar bzhin la/ sgrub pa po'i kha zhi ba la nub dang / dbang la shar du blta zhing gzhan gnyis kyang sngar las bzlog nas bya'o/ /de yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ 'di ni dkyil 'khor khang pa yis/ /shar gyi phyogs su bya ba yin/ /zhes dang / grong ni byang gi phyogs su ni/ /'di dag nyid ni rtag tu bya/ /zhes dang / dbang chen nub kyi phyogs su ni/ /thab khung 'di yi phyogs rim bya/ /lho phyogs kyi ni cha ru gnas/ /zhes so/ /'di la khyab bdag bla mas gzhan rnams ma nges kyang drag po la lhor blta ba nges can du mdzad na'ang / mdun bskyed gtso bor gyur pa'i tshe byang du bltas kyang mi 'gal lam snyam mo/ /de nas zhi rgyas sogs te/ kha blta phyogs lugs gzhan bstan pa ni/ gong du bshad zin te/ drug pa thun mong du 'jug pa dgang blug bshad pa la/ rab 'bring tha la gsum las/ dang po gnyis la rgyu thun mong du dang / tshad so sor bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gser la sogs pa'am sogs te/ 'byor pa dang ldan pa'i dgang blug gi rgyu gser dngul dang / zangs sogs las byas pa dang / de ma 'byor na u dum wa ra dang nim pa'i shing sogs las bya ste/

rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ gser ram dngul lam zangs sam ni/ /mchod sbyin shing gi rang bzhin gyis/ /zhes dang / legs bsdus las/ gser sogs rdzas dang mchod sbyin shing / /yang na nim pa'i shing dang ni/ /zhes dang / rin chen 'bar ba las/ gser sogs nim pa mchod sbyin shing / /zhes dang / a bha yas/ dgang gzar ni/ gser ram zangs kyi rang bzhin nam/ /mchod sbyin shing gi ngo bo ste/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa tshad bshad pa la gnyis las/ dang po che ba'i tshad ni/ dgang gzar gyi kha'i sogs te/ tshig don ni rtogs par sla la/ 'di rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud rgyas pa dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las gsungs pa'i don mi thub zla ba yab sras kyis drangs par gsungs pa las/ gdan bzhi'i rgyud rgyas pa ni/ gangs can 'dir ma byon la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las gsung pa ni 'di yin te/ rgyud de las/ rtsa la sogs par dbyug tshad de/ /steng du gru bzhi rab mdzes par/ /sor mo gnyis tshad 'og tu khru/ /ye shes rdo rjes rnam par spras/ /slar yang de steng sor bzhi'i tshad/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma lta bur bya/ /lha mo de yi bu ga ni/ /mthe 'u chung gi tshad tsam yin/ /rdo rje rin chen sor mo drug /de yi dbyug pa'i sna ru bya/ /zhes dgang gzar dang / kha ni pad+ma'i 'dab ma bzhin/ /mchu ru sor mo gnyis kyi tshad/ /sngon bzhin mtshan nyid rnams dang ldan/ /dbus su rdo rje mdzes pas mtshan/ /zhes pas blug gzar bstan pa yin no/ /de dag gi don sbyangs dka' zla ba yab sras kyi bkral ba las thog mar legs bsdu nas 'byung ba ni/ dgang gzar ring tshad khru do pa/ /de yi dbye ba bshad par bya/ /mchu zheng sor mo brgyad pa la/ /khung bu de yi phyed mnyam brkos/ /brkos pa dang mnyam rdo rje bru/ /kha ni pad+ma'i 'dab ma mtshungs/ /mu khyud kyang ni gru bzhi ste/ /kun tu sor mo bzhi yin no/ /sor gnyis brkos pa de yi tshad/ /rdo rje rtse gsum pa nang du/ /'di yi khu bcud 'dzag pa yis/

/bu ga mtheb chung tshad tsam yin/ /ska rags 'og tu de'i tshad/ /mdzes pa 'dab ma dag gi gnas/ /smyo byed me tog dang mtshungs pa/ /yu ba'i mgo bor pad+ma bya/ /yu 'og sor gnyis rin po che/ /mtha' mar rdo rje sor drug pa/ /zhes dgang gzar dang / phyed bcas khru gang blugs gzar du/ /shes bya 'di yi kha sor drug /chu skyes 'dab ma'i rnams pa mtshungs/ /de yi dbus su zheng zabs su/ /sor gsum bru bya de tshar tsam/ /rtse lnga pa yi rdo rjes mtshan/ /sor gnyis mdzes par byed pa'i gnas/ /rin chen sor gcig shes par bya/ /zhes blugs gzar bshad nas de dag gi yu ba'i sbom phra yang / dgang gzar yu ba 'chang pa yis/ /gzung bar 'os pa'i tshad tsam yin/ /zhes dang / cung zad phra ba blugs gzar gyi/ /rdo rjer sor gsum bya ba 'o/ /zhes so/ /rin chen 'bar ba las byung ba ni/ yu ba khru do mchu sor brgyad/ /zheng zabs rdo rjer sor bzhi 'o/ /kha ni pad+ma'i rnam pa mtshungs/ /ska rags gru bzhi mdzes pa ste/ /'og tu pad+ma legs par bya/ /rin chen sor gnyis yu ba'i mgor/ /tha mar rdo rje sor drug pa/ /de ni dgang gzar mtshan nyid do/ /zhes dgang gzar dang / blugs gzar yu ba khru gang ste/ /mchur ni sor drug zheng dang zabs/ /rdo rje sor gsum pad 'dab mtshungs/ /rin chen sor gcig gsum rdo rje/ /zhes blugs gzar ro/ /'dir gnyis ka drangs pa ni/ rje btsun nyid kyis gnyis ka shes byed du gsung pa dang / legs bsdus las/ blugs gzar gyi yu ba khru phyed do dang / rin chen 'bar ba las/ de'i yu ba khru gang par bshad pa sogs don gyi dang / tshig la yang 'gyur bde khyad che bar 'dug pas bris pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ dgang blugs chung ba'i sogs te/ 'di la chung bar bshad pa ni snga ma la ltos nas yin la/ 'bring por byas pa ni gsum gsungs pa la ltos nas der bzhag pa yin no/ /de yang gnyis ka'i sogs te tshig gi don ni go bar zad la/

'di nyid ye shes thig le las 'byung zhes pa ni/ rgyud de las mar khu'i snod dang bcas nas gsung ste/ ji skad du dgang gzar blugs gzar mar gyi snod rin po che ru bstan/ lag pa yi ni dbyug pa'i tshad/ /'bad pa yis ni dgang gzar bya/ /dgang gzar ji bzhin blugs gzar te/ /mar bzhu'i snod ni de dang mnyam/ /gru gsum zlum po'i rnam pa dang / /rdo rje yis ni rnam par brgyan/ /zhes mdor bstan nas rgyas par bshad pa ni/ dgang gzar gyi ni kha zhes bya/ /sor drug pa yis tshad du ni/ /mgo bo yang ni de bzhin bya/ /thams cad kun tu gru bzhi bya/ /sna tshogs rdo rje snying ka ru/ /lte ba pad+ma yis ni brgyan/ /chu srin kha nas byung ba yi/ /rtse dgu pa yi rdo rje yis/ /dgang gzar gyi ni mtha' ru ldan/ /zhes dgang gzar dang / blugs gzar ba yis mi dang 'dra/ /yang na de ni pad+mas so/ /nang gi gting ring gsal ba dang / /ha cang ring dang thung ma yin/ /rdo rje phra mos nang du brgyan/ /zhes blugs gzar dang / mar bzhu'i snod ni zlum por grags/ /lte ba ring zhing dri ma med/ /rdo rje la sogs rgyan dang ldan/ /zhes so/ /de'i mar khu'i snod ni/ rgyu rin po che las byas pa la tshad dgang blugs dang mnyam par gsung pa'i don ni khru gang zlum por byas pa'i rgya dang / zabs su ji ltar rig par byas pa'i kha la rdo rjes brgyan pa ste/ gong du mar bzhu'i sogs dang / 'og tu yang mar bzhu'i sogs rkang pa gsum gsung pas bstan nam snyam mo/ /'on kyang rgyud 'di'i 'grel pa rdo rje gsang bas mdzad pa bod byon pas de rnyed na rtag go /dgang blug 'bring po 'di ni rin chen 'bar ba las kyang gsungs te/ gzhan yang dgang gzar blugs gzar gyis/ /yu ba khru gang bya ba ste/ /'og tu rdo rje rin chen bya/ /de yi dgang gzar rgyar sor bzhi/ /zabs su sor bzhi nang rdo rje/ /sor bzhi'i mthar ni rdo rje ste/ /bar du pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i dbyibs/

/blugs gzar bar dbyibs sor gnyis te/ /zabs su sor gcig nang rdo rje/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ dgang blugs shin tu bsdus pa sogs te/ 'di yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro las 'byung bar gsungs pa ni/ rgyud de las/ sor mo lnga yi rab sbyor bas/ /dgang blugs gsum ni yang dag mtshungs/ /gzhan yang sor mo gsum po dag /shibs pa 'di yi bsreg blugs sbyin/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin du rin chen 'bar ba las kyang / yang na sor mo lnga dang gsum/ /gcer bas kyang ni bya bar gsungs/ /zhes so/ /sbyor ba'i chos rnams bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i chos la drug ste/ lha bsgom me btsal yo byad bsangs/ /thab khung 'du bya 'jig rten dang / /'das pa'i me lha mchod pa 'o/ /zhes pa'i dang po ni/ bdag gi rnal 'byor sogs te/ yab yum gang dang 'brel yang lha'i rnal 'byor bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis bsdus pa bsgoms kyang dgag par bya ba ma yin la/ deng sang gi phyag len la ni gzhung 'di yab kyi phyogs kho na gsungs nas/ de'i bskyed chog gi chings kyang yan lag drug par bshad pa 'di gtso bor mdzad pa snang ngo / /de la skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar gyi 'od zer spro bsdu dang / bzlas pa'i sngags rnams las bzhi gang dang 'brel ba'i kha dog tu byas la so so'i grangs kyi nges pa 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin no/ /long skabs dang bstun nas ji ltar rigs pa bzla'o/ /de nas bdag gi bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor la phyi nang gi yid las byung ba'i mchod bstod rnams byas la/ dkyil 'khor bsdus te phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis tha mal gyi gtam smra ba sogs spang te so so'i cho ga la 'jug go /de dag kyang rin chen 'bar ba las/ legs ldan sngon 'gro nas brtsams te/ /mchod bstod bar gyi sbyor ldan pas/ /zhes dang / de nyid las/ de nas slob dpon rang lha yi/ /sbyor rdzogs gtso bo'i bdag nyid kyis/

/zhes gsungs pa 'di dag gi skabs 'di lta bu mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba phal che ba'i shes byed yin no/ /de bzhin du a bha yas kyang / las dang rjes su mthun pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor gyi bsrung ba las sogs pa dang bzlas pa byas shing mi smra bas/ zhes so/ /'di man gyi cho ga rnams zhi ba'i cho ga zur na yod pa las rtogs dgos par gsung na'ang / de 'dir drangs na yi ge mang bar 'gyur bas gang gi bsdu don bzhin du bshad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang rang gi yam shing la rang rang gi me sbar/ thab kyi dbyibs dang mthun par 'jam po gsum la g.yas bskor dang / drag po la g.yon nas bskor la de'i tshe yab kyi phyogs la snying po dang / yum gyi phyogs la de'i rang sngags bzla/ de nas dz+wa la sogs brjod cing thab tu bcug la rtswa skam po dang lci ba'i phye ma dang / sngags de nyid bzla zhing rang rang gi mar dgang blugs gsum bud shing thab kyi dbyibs dang mthun par brtsigs pa la blugs nas/ rlung g.yab kyis g.yob cing me gso bar bya ste/ pad can las/ rlung g.yab g.yab pas me sbar nas/ /oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ zhes brjod/ /rtswa dang lci ba skam po yis/ /phye mas de nas me sbar bya/ /zhes dang / a bha yas/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐/ zhes pa 'di dang yi ge hūm̐ gis kyang rlung g.yab kyis me sbar nas/ rigs kyi snying po lan bdun bzlas pa'i blugs gzar gyis kyang me rab tu sbar bar bya'o/ /zhes so/ /'dir rlung g.yab kyis me sbar bar bshad pa'i dgos pa ni/ khas bus pa sogs mi gtsang ba rnams dgag pa'i ched yin te/ dri med 'od las/ 'dir thab rab tu 'bar bar byed pa'i dus su me yang dag par 'bar ba'i don du kha'i rlung mi bya ste/ rlung g.yab kyi rlung la sogs pas bya'o/ /zhes so/ gsum pa ni/ lha'i nga rgyal stan pos las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i bsang chu/ sngags de nyid brjod cing thab la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams la gtor nas bgegs kyi tshogs bskrad par bya ste/

rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ blo ldan las kun sngags bzlas ste/ /yo byad kun la bsang bar bya/ /zhes so/ /de nas yo byad rnams swa bha wa shu d+dha sogs rang bzhin dag pa'i sngags brjod pas stong par sbyangs la/ de'i ngang las gong du bstan pa'i snod rnams de dang de'i rnam pa'am/ legs bsdus gtor ma'i skabs las/ a las byung ba'i pad snod bsam/ /zhes pa sogs a las thod par bskyed pa'i nang du hūm̐ las mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas rnams bskyed pa ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ sna tshogs hūm̐ ni rdzogs pa dang / /zhes pa'i 'grel pa pad can las/ sna tshogs hūm̐ las skyes pa zhes pa ni/ so sor me tog la sogs pa hūm̐ las skyes pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de dag byin gyis rlobs pa'i phya rgya dang sngags rnams ni rdo rje gdan bzhi las/ lag gnyis khu tshur kha sbyar te/ /gung mo gnyis kyang kun tu blta/ /phyag rgya 'di ni dag byed pa'o/ /oṃ shri swā hā/ mar sbyangs pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ swa swā hā/ rdzas bkru ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hā/ 'bru sbyangs pa'i sngags so/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ rdzas gzhan sbyangs pa'i sngags so/ oṃ ā swā hā/ yam shing sbyangs pa'i sngags so/ zhes dang / legs bsdus las/ sngar gyi tshig rkang gsum po'i phyi ma la/ rdzas gzhan sbyangs pa'i sngags yin no/ /zhes pa ma gtogs gong ma ji lta ba bzhin dang / rin chen 'bar ba las/ de nas yam shing la sogs rdzas bsangs la sbyangs shing sngags 'di 'don/ zhes pa'i rjes su sngags rnams kyang snga ma ltar gsungs so/ /mchod rdzas rnams kyi chu bzhi'i phyag rgya yang de nyid yin zhing sngags ni mi thub zla ba yab sras kyis/ oṃ ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ/ zhabs bsil gyi sngags so/ /zhes sogs yin no/ /nyer spyod kyi phyag rgya ni gur nas 'byung ba'i don rin chen 'bar ba las/ me tog bskur ba'i tshul gyi dang / /spos la yal ga'i sbyor ba dang / /sdong pos mar me'i mchod pa dang /

/byug pa'i lugs kyi rjes su dri/ /zhes pa rnams yin la/ sngags ni rtsa rgyud las/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa rnams yin no/ /'di ni deng sang gi phyag len bzhin bshad pa yin la/ khyab bdag bla mas ni/ rang gi lag pa gnyis kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros nas rdzas rnams la phog pas/ rdzas rnams kyi skyon thams cad dag nas dngas shing thogs pa med pa las bsgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur las dgung mo gnyis gshib la bskyangs te/ oṃ shri swā hā/ zhes sogs kyis sreg rdzas sbyangs pa dang / de nas mchod rdzas sbyangs pa sogs gsungs te/ 'di ni blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyi snying la sim par bya ba'i legs bshad kyi bdud rtsir 'dug go /bzhi pa ni/ thab khung sogs te/ slar yang rang bzhin dag pa'i sngags brjod pas thab khung stong par sbyangs la de'i ngang las gzhan nas yo ga rnams dang rang gi lha'i snying po las bskyed par bshad kyang / 'dir sa bon las bskyed pa ste/ a bha yas/ de nas lha'i bdag nyid rang gi lha'i sa bon gyi thab nges par rdzogs par bskyed par bya ste/ zhes pa ltar hūm̐ las sogs te sa bon de las bskyed pa'i thab khung ni las kyi dbye bas tha dad du 'gyur bas na/ zhi ba la sogs te so so'i thab tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa bskyed par bya'o/ /de dag gi lung ni gong du bshad zin to/ /lnga pa ni/ 'jig sogs te/ so so'i thab kyi me yi dbus su paṃ rang gi yi ge dag las pad nyi'i gdan bskyed la de'i steng du/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ lug gi steng du gnas pa dang / gzhan nas pad nyi tsam las srog chags kyi gdan ma gsungs pa yang yod mod/ 'dir ra skyes kyi gdan la gnas par bshad pa ni cho ga gzhan dang thun mong yin no/

/de nas gong ma'i man ngag las ni cho ga gsum las bskyed par gsungs la/ rgyud bstan bcos gzhan las ni sa bon kho na las bskyed par gsal te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ yi ge raṃ las nges 'byung ba/ zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ de dbus raṃ yig sa bon las/ /kha dog dmar po mdzes pa'i zhal/ /zhes dang / mi thub zla ba yab sras kyis/ ra yi skyes gnas las byung bsgom/ /zhes dang / pad can las/ shes rab kyis chags raṃ las byung / /zhes dang / a bha yas/ raṃ yig las skyes pa pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'am/ zhes so/ /de ltar cho ga gsum mam sa bon las bskyed pa gang ltar yang lha'i ngo bo ni kha sbyor dang / mi thub zla ba yab sras la sogs pas zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa dang / a bha ya la sogs pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum dang bcas pa dang / gzhan dpal 'dzin dang dzā+e tā ri sogs/ gyi zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rgyud dang bstan bcos so so nas bshad tshul mi 'dra ba du ma gsung pa las/ 'dir zhal gcig phyag bzhi par mdzad pa ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la brten pa ste/ rgyud de las/ me yi khams kyi rang bzhin te/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba can/ /lto chen zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /zhes so/ /de'i phyag mtshan ni/ kha sbyor dang mthun par mdzad pa ste/ de nyid las/ lag pa dang po ni mchog sbyin/ gnyis pa ni bgrang phreng / g.yon pa ril pa spyi blugs nyid dang / gnyis pa na dbyug gu nyid dang / zhes so/ /'on kyang g.yon pa gnyis kyi go rim ni/ legs bsdus las/ g.yon na dbyug pa spyi blugs so/ /zhes pa ltar mdzad par snang ngo / /gzhan las ni phyag mtshan la yang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ kha cig las/ g.yas na rtse gsum dang / rdo rje dbyug pa/ g.yon na phreng ba dang spyi blugs dang / 'ga' zhig gis a bha yas/ g.yas kyi dang po skyabs sbyin dang / la la mtsho skyes kyis g.yon gnyis bum pa spyi blugs 'dzin par mdzad pa sogs mi 'dra ba du ma yod mod/

skabs de dang der de bzhin du nyams su len pa yin no/ /de'i kha dog dang rgyan dang bsam pa la sogs pa ni gang sgrub po'i khyad par gyi skabs su bshad pa dag mtshungs par las gang dang 'brel ba de bzhin du bskyed pa ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ las dang rjes mthun mdog dang ni/ /rgyan dang gos la sogs par ldan/ /zhes dang / mi thub zla ba yab sras kyis/ las dang rjes mthun kha dog can/ /zhes dang / pad can las/ las dang rjes mthun rnam shes dang / /'od zer gdan bcas gsus po che/ /zhes dang / a bha yas/ las dang rjes su mthun pa'i sku mdog dang gos dang rgyan dang ldan pa/ rnam par shes pa'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba dang ldan pa/ zhes so/ /yang na sku mdog dmar po nyid la/ bsam pa dang / 'od zer las so so'i kha dog can du bsam ste/ kha sbyor las/ kha dog dmar zhing ral pa chen po dang me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas shing / las kyi 'od zer gyis brgyan pa ste/ zhes dang / de nyid las/ las kyi 'od zer gyis rnam par brgyan pa zhes bya ba ni/ zhi ba la sogs pa las kyi ci rigs par 'od kyi rnam par spras pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de ltar dam tshig pa bskyed pa'i skabs 'dir/ de nyid las 'khor yang bod gzhung rnams las bshad pa mang du mthong zhing de bzhin phyag len la yang mdzad par snang mod/ rgyud dang bstan bcos rnams las ni ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi tshe de la 'khor yod par gsung gi 'dir gsal bar bshad pa ma mthong zhing don la yang nges par mi dgos sam snyam mo/ /de ltar na spyan drangs pa'i 'khor rnams ci ltar bya zhe na/ de ni dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon par rtogs pa gzhan la bya ba bzhin me lha nyid la bstim chog pas dgos pa'i gnas med do/ /'on kyang rnam par dpyad pa las zhe 'dod kyis spangs pa ni ma yin no/ /de nas skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ man ngag lugs la skabs 'di dang / dkyus ma nyid la ni ye shes pa bcug nas bya ba yin la/

de gnyis gang ltar yang ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa'i 'od zer gyi kha dog ni las dang mthun pa yin zhing / de spro ba'i gzhi ni snga ma la bdag dang me lha gang rung gi thugs ka nas dang / phyi ma la bdag gi thugs ka 'ba' zhig nas spro ba yin no/ /de yang me lha'i thugs ka nas spro ba ni/ a bha yas/ dam tshig sems dpa'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyi lcags kyus nam mkha' la dam tshig sems dpa' dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' me yi mtshams nas byon nas/ zhes pa ltar yin la/ bdag gi thugs ka nas spro ba ni/ cho ga gzhan dang thun mong ba yin no/ /de ltar spros pa'i 'od zer dang / gdan bzhi las/ g.yon pa khu tshur bcings nas su/ /khro bo dang ni gung mo brkyangs/ /dbu ma'i tshigs ni gsum pa la/ /khro bo bskums te bcug pas dgug /ces gsungs pa la brten nas/ dam pa kha cig g.yas kho na dang / la las lag pa gnyis kas byed par gsungs mod/ gang ltar na'ang phyag rgya de dang / rin chen 'bar ba las 'byung ba'i tshigs su bcad pa gnyis dang / kha sbyor nas gsungs pa'i oṃ ag+na ye sogs sngags dang bcas pas shar lho nas me lha de dang rigs mthun gyi drang srong dpag tu med pas bskor ba bkug nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rjes/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ gi yi ges thab khung gi me mtshams su bzhugs pa la/ zhes pa ltar/ thab kyi shar lhor 'khod par bsam pa ste/ kha sbyor las/ kha dog dmar pos rnam par rgyan cing drang srong rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba/ zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ de nas me lha spyan drangs ste/ /me yis phyogs nas byon pa ni/ /drang srong rnams kyi yongs su bskor/ /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ gis yi ge ni/ /thab khung logs su bzhag bya ste/ /zhes dang / pad can las/ spyan 'dren gyi sngags gsungs pa'i rjes su/ nye bar byed pa'i sngags 'di yis/ /thab khung 'gram du bzhag par bya/ /zhes so/ /'di la gong ma'i man ngag gi pad+ma'i gdan dbul bar mdzad la/

a bha ya la sogs pas ni/ ku sha'i stan la bzhugs par bshad/ oṃ āḥdzaḥhūm̐/ zhes pa 'dis bkug la thab tu me yi phyogs kyi ku sha'i chun po la 'dug la zhes so/ /de ltar gnas pa la chu bzhis mchod pa sogs bya ste/ sdom 'byung las/ bsangs gtor 'thor 'thung mchod yon sogs/ /byin nas thab kyi dbus su bzhag /ces dang / legs bsdus las/ de la zhabs bsil zhal bsil dang / /'thor 'thung mchod yon rim bzhin dbul/ /zhes dang / rin chen 'bar ba las kyang de bzhin du 'byung ngo / /de nas dam tshig sgrags pa ni/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya ston pa'am/ mi thub zla ba yab sras kyis/ spos khang yongs su bzung bya ste/ /'dod don dngos grub rtogs bya'i phyir/ /dam tshig yang dag brjod par bya/ /zhes pa ltar spos dang bcas pas gur dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs las gsungs pa'i sngags brjod pas dam phyag len la dril bu bkrol ba'ang mdzad/ la bzhag ste las bzhi gang dang 'brel pa de thogs med du sgrub par khas blangs par bsam mo/ /de la ku sha 'bul ba ni/ mi thub zla ba yab sras kyis chu bzhis mchod pa'i rjes thogs nyid du bya bar bshad na'ang / rje btsun gyis 'og tu bya bar gsungs pas de bzhin 'chad do/ /de ltar mchod nas thab kyi dam tshig pa gsal bar dmigs la rnal 'byor ma bzhis ye shes pa rnams dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya ste/ gur las gsung pa don legs bsdu sogs kyi gtor ma'i skabs las/ dkar mos dgug par byas nas ni/ /chos rkun ma yi zhags pas bcings/ /ro langs ma yis lcags sgrog sdoms/ /za phod ma yis dril bu dbang / /zhes so/ /skabs 'dir a bha yas ni gong du ji skad bshad pa'i ye shes pa 'jug tshul la rgyas pa dang / spyan drangs ma thag tu dgug gzhug sogs byas nas/ mchod pa rnams 'dra bar byas pa la bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i rnam gzhag kyang mdzod do/ /de nas skye mched dang gnas gsum sgrub thabs ltar mdzad la/

de yang rin chen 'bar ba'i bskyed rim gyi skabs las/ mig dang rna ba sna lce lus/ /yid kyi skye mched rnam dag pa/ /gti mug zhe sdang ser rna dang / /'dod chags phrag dog rdo rje ma/ /bdag med ma rnams rang gnas dgod/ /lus ngag yid gsum rnam dag pa/ /mkha' spyod sa spyod sa 'og ma/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gnas su 'o/ /zhes so/ /dir de ltar bzhed pa ni tshul de nyid cho ga gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pas byas na legs pa la dgongs la/ mi thub zla bas ni skabs 'dir gnas gsum byin rlabs tsam gyis chog par bzhed de/ legs bsdus las/ sku gsum byin gyis rlabs par bya/ /zhes pa 'di las ma gsungs shing / de'i gong 'brel dag las kyang / skye mched byin rlabs ma gsung pas so/ /de nas dbang bskur ba'i phyir 'od zer gong ltar spros pas/ dbang lha spyan drangs nas dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyi dbang bskur ba'i chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ zhi ba la rnam snang / rgyas pa la rin 'byung / dbang la 'od dpag med/ drag po la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam ste/ legs bsdus las/ rang rig lha yi cod pan can/ /zhes so/ /de nas de la mchod pa ni/ kha cig gis dam tshig sgrags pa'i rjes su mdzad na'ang / rje btsun gyis 'dir mdzad pa ni/ me lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su byas ma thag mchod par cho ga gzhan dang mthun par dgongs shing / slob dpon gzhan yang de bzhin du bzhed do/ /ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ rin chen 'bar ba las/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la mchod pa dang thun mong du mdzad nas/ 'chad pa'i cho gas mchod nas ni zhes 'og gi mchod chog rgyas pa la kha 'phangs mdzad pa de yin la/ skabs de'i phyag len la ni/ tshigs bcad rnams dor nas mchod pa rnams kyi ming yig ge'i mgor/ me lha'i mtshan sngags sbyar ba'i phyi mchod nang mchod dang bstan bcos de las 'byung ba'i bstod pa'i tshigs bcad dang po 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs dang bcas pa tsam mdzad do/

/de la yang 'khor dang bcas pa zhes pa'i tshig sbyar dgos mi dgos gong bzhin shes par bya'o/ /de nas ku sha 'bul ba la kha sbyor las/ thab khung kun tu ku sha yi/ /rtse mo drang pos yongs su bskor/ /zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ ku sha g.yas su bskor te dgram/ /ljang khu ma nyams 'dab ma can/ /so so'i rtse mo dri med pa/ /ha cang ring min thung ba min/ /las dang rjes mthun gong dang gong / /shar la sogs pa'i mdun du ni/ /kha khyer la ni g.yas bskor du/ /phyogs kyis dbye ba rnam bzhag pas/ /thab khung de yi kha dgab bya/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du slob dpon kha cig dang bcas pas me lha ma bskyed gong du bshad pa dang / mi thub zla ba yab sras kyis lha bskyed zin nas bya bar gsungs pa'i snga ma ni/ sngon du bshams nas phyis 'bul ba'i cho ga tsam gyis chog pa dang / phyi ma ni/ cho ga dang 'brel ba lhan cig byas chog pa la dgongs pa'o/ /'bul tshul dang po ni/ slob dpon gzhan gyis badz+ra sa twa kho na brjod pas 'bul ba las ma bshad kyang / gong ma'i man ngag gi sa bon hūm̐ las bskyed nas/ nag po spyod pa'i gzhung las 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad oṃ ku sha sogs/ dang / pad can las/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥzhes brjod nas/ zhes pa dang / a bha yas/ de nas ku sha rnams la oṃ badz+ra satwa a/ zhes pa 'di brjod la/ zhes bshad pa'i sngags 'di brjod cing dbul bar gsung pa ltar bya'o/ /de yang thab kyi shar nas brtsams te 'jam po gsum la g.yas bskor dang / drag po la bzlog nas bskor te rtse mo rnams bskor phyogs su bstan nas/ thab stegs yod na de'i steng dang / med na kha gyer gyi steng du 'jog pa yin te/ legs bsdus las/ ha cang ring min rtse ma nyams/ /shar bltas g.yas bskor ku sha dgram/ /rtse mo phyogs gcig bstan byas te/ /kha khyer steng du gzhag par bya/ /zhes dang / rin chen 'bar ba las/ ha cang ring min rtse ma nyams/ /g.yas bskor shar nas ku sha dgram/

/rtse mo phyogs gcig bstan byas te/ /stegs bu'i steng du bzhag par bya/ /zhes so/ /de nas skabs 'dir 'bul ba'i mar la/ bla ma rnams kyis byon zan dang byon skyems zhes pa'i tha snyad mi 'dra bar mdzad la/ de ltar gyi tshe zhu ba'i rdzas yin pas byon skyems su rigs shing de yang 'jig rten gyi tha snyad dang bstun par snang ngo / /de 'bul ba la mi thub zla bas ni/ rtse gsum rdo rje ldan pa'i lce/ /zhes pa tsam las mi gsal yang / man ngag gi me lha'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse gsum pa hūm̐ gis mtshan par bskyed pa la raṃ yig gis brgyan pa dang / dgang blugs kyi gzar bu'i kha la yang hūm̐ dang raṃ gyis mtshan par bya ste/ pad can las/ me khar yi ge raṃ bkod la/ /zhes dang / a bha yas/ me lha'i zhal du raṃ rnam par bkod la/ zhes dang / mi thub zla ba yab sras kyis/ dgang gzar blugs gzar bzang po yis/ /rdo rjes mtshan par sa bon bsgom/ /zhes dang / rin chen 'bar ba las/ dgang gzar blugs gzar khar rang gi /lha yi sa bon rab 'bar bsam/ /re pha'ang de yi khar dgod bya/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i dgang blugs kyi gzar bu las dang mthun pa'i khu tshur gyis gzung la/ gru mo gnyis dge ba'i las gsum la rang rang gi 'dug stangs las dpus mo'i phyir mi 'da' ba dang / gdug pa'i las la g.yas sngar dang 'dra zhing g.yon pa phyir phyung ba'am/ ci bder bya ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ zhi la byang chub mchog gis gzung / /rgyas la rin chen khu tshur gyis/ /dbang dang dgug pa dag la ni/ /pad+ma'i khu tshur gyis ni zungs/ /de bzhin khro bo'i khu tshur gyis/ /nan tan du ni 'dug la bya/ /zhes dang / de nyid las/ dpus mo'i bar du lag bzhag ste/ /dge ba'i las la sbyin sreg bya/ /gang phyir spyi dang nang du yang / /lag pa g.yon gyis dge min pa'o/ /zhes so/ /phyag rgya de dag gi 'ching tshul las/ byang chub mchog ni de nyid bsdus par/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje mdzub mo ni/

/g.yas pa'i nang du sgreng bar bya/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad sbyin byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong gnyis shibs te steng nas bkab ba'i tshul du bzhag pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dam tshig gi khu tshur yin zhing / de gnyis su byas pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur yin la/ de nyid las/ g.yon pa'i mdzub mo bsgreng pa g.yas pa'i nang du bzung ba ni byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya yin la/ de gnyis su byas pa byang chub mchog gi khu tshur du don gyis thob cing 'di la mthe bong gnyis nang du shor nas/ g.yon khro bo'i khu tshur dang g.yas rdo rje khu tshur du 'gyur ba'i skyon yod do/ /rgyas pa la sogs phyi ma gsum ni/ dpal chog las/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i mdzub mo bkug pa'i sor mo mnyam pa'i mthe bong rdo rjer bkab pa rdo rje nor bu'o/ /de gnyis su byas na rin po che'i khu tshur ro/ /zhes rin chen gyis dang / rdo rje bsdams pa'i mdzub mo gnyis bkug la mthe bong mnyam par brkyangs la/ dbu ma gnyis phyi rol du gshib pa dang bcas pa bzhag ste/ de gnyis su byas pa pad+ma'i khu tshur ro/ /zhes pad+ma'i dang / rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mo sdigs mdzub bo/ /zhes khro bo'i khu tshur rnams gsal bar 'byung ba bzhin bya'o/ /'bul ba dngos ni/ lag pa g.yon pa kha gyen du bstan pas dgang gzar bzung la/ g.yas pa kha sbub tu byas pas/ blugs gzar bzung nas mar blangs la me sngags sam/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ mar sngags zhes pa brjod bzhin pa bdun gyis bkangs te/ kha sbyor nas gsungs pa'i sngags bzla zhing dgang blugs kha sbyar nas me lha'i zhal du dbul bar bya ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ mngon par 'dod pa grub bya'i phyir/ /de yi zhal du dgang blugs dbul/ /zhes dang / sdom 'byung las/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes/ /dang por sreg blugs sbyin par bya/
